request.note: No payload. The handler does not read `data`, so any payload (also `null`) works.

responses.name: Gone
responses.when: First, one for each entity that the socket saw before and does not see now. The observer and the character each get their own set.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The entity that left the view.

fields.name: outside
fields.description: Always `true`: the entity is out of view, it did not die.

responses.name: Snapshot
responses.when: Then one full snapshot, for the observer of the socket (if any), then one for the character (if any). With neither, the server sends nothing.

confirm.note: Sent only when the instance of the observer exists (node/server_functions.js:3707)

order: `disappear` `{id, outside: true}` for each entity that left the view of the observer, then `entities` for the observer
the same for the character: `disappear` events, then `entities`
